description: Static assertions for leo-assist — phase-aware Leo AI prompt suite (P0-P4 + QC + Install) grounded in Leo's verified strengths (calc-with-citation, part-search, standards), classification-gated, geometry redirected to helix-cad-bridge/leo-prompt
test_input: generate Leo prompts to support the design lifecycle P0 to P4 plus QC and installation, using Leo for what it is actually good at

assertions.name: covers_all_phases
assertions.check: covers P0 P1 P2 P3 P4 + QC + Installation

assertions.name: six_strength_modes
assertions.check: 6 strength-based modes A-F (Part-Search, Q&A, Calculation, DFM-Inspect, Documentation/BOM, Material-Selection) as a phase×mode matrix

assertions.name: router_meta_prompt
assertions.check: ships a router meta-prompt that picks mode from a one-line task
assertions.regex: Router|router|điều phối tác vụ|chọn 1.?2 mode|1 dòng tác vụ

assertions.name: leo_real_strengths
assertions.check: grounded in Leo's verified strengths — citation-backed calc, part-search (120M vendor/PLM), standards, DFMA — NOT production geometry
assertions.regex: trích nguồn|part-search|tìm part|120M|vendor|DFMA|tính toán có cite|standards

assertions.name: no_production_geometry
assertions.check: explicitly states Leo does NOT generate production CAD (mesh only), redirects geometry to helix-cad-bridge / leo-prompt

assertions.name: classification_gate
assertions.check: classification gate THUONG vs MAT, never upload MAT geometry/PLM to cloud, abstraction rule

assertions.name: five_leo_principles
assertions.check: enforces quantified load case + FoS, real interface dims, source citation, search-before-generate

assertions.name: phase_to_internal_skill
assertions.check: routes each phase to the internal HELIX/forge skill that consumes Leo's output

assertions.name: verify_before_use
assertions.check: Leo outputs are approximate — CEO/CAD verify before entering MAT drawing/BOM

assertions.name: fillin_templates
assertions.check: ships ready-to-fill per-phase prompt templates in a reference

assertions.name: p3_partsearch_strongest
assertions.check: P3 embodiment flagged as Leo's strongest (COTS part-search: bearings, rails, fasteners)
assertions.regex: P3.*⭐|mạnh nhất|bạc đạn|ray tuyến tính|fastener|COTS|mua ngoài

assertions.name: research_grounded
assertions.check: references the getleo.ai research and LLM Spatial Blindness
